steps.name: preflight
steps.command: set -euo pipefail; git fetch --prune origin; test "$(git rev-parse origin/develop)" = "f6f316308520cff744b8a02545a5dedb09b27dbc"; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"

steps.name: baseline-build
steps.command:
set -euo pipefail; cd interface; npm ci --ignore-scripts >/dev/null; npm run build >/tmp/matrixhub-baseline-build.log 2>&1; python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
root=Path('build')
rows=[]
for p in root.rglob('*'):
 if p.is_file() and not p.name.endswith('.gz'):
  rows.append((p.stat().st_size,str(p.relative_to(root))))
print('BASE_TOTAL',sum(s for s,_ in rows),'FILES',len(rows))
for s,p in sorted(rows,reverse=True)[:30]: print('BASE',s,p)
Path('/tmp/matrixhub-base-sizes.tsv').write_text('\n'.join(f'{p}\t{s}' for s,p in rows))
PY

steps.name: updated-build
